title: Auto Policy - Roadside Assistance
text: Roadside assistance covers towing up to 25 miles, battery jump-starts, and flat tire changes, limited to 3 uses per policy year.

title: Home Policy - Water Damage
text: Water damage from sudden and accidental plumbing failures is covered. Gradual leaks or damage from lack of maintenance are excluded.

title: Auto Policy - Rental Reimbursement
text: If your covered vehicle is in the shop after an approved claim, rental reimbursement covers up to $40/day for a maximum of 20 days.

title: Claims - Appeal Window
text: A denied claim may be appealed in writing within 30 days of the denial letter date, with any new supporting documentation.
